pages.text: Open the Atum advancement tab after obtaining a Scarab. Enter the dimension for Journey Into The Sands. Visit a living oasis for A Hope and a dead oasis for A Mirage. Survey all ten for A Journey.
Grow crops for Agriculture, tame your companions, then explore a ruin for Ruined It or enter a pyramid for Pyramid Scheme. Wash relics for Just Like New and Powerwasher.
Defeating a Pharaoh earns Kingslayer. Collect divine pieces for It Belongs In A Museum and the larger collection goal, The Full Museum. Use the guide’s chapters to plan your next expedition.
